resources.string: Use the general delay, or choose a shorter or longer delay for this app. Increasing a delay takes effect immediately. Reducing it waits for the difference: changing 6 hours to 4 hours waits 2 hours. Returning to a shorter general delay follows the same rule. Changes that affect every app use the longest applicable delay.
Protection stays off until you enable it.
DomainGuard will stay on.\n\nCancel the %1$s pause scheduled to start at %2$s.
Your existing rules will apply again immediately.\n\nThe pause was due to end at %1$s.
The pause changed. Please review its current state.
The wait starts when you tap %1$s. Your current rules stay active during the wait.
The wait starts when you tap Pause. DomainGuard keeps protecting you during the wait. Your %1$s pause starts afterward.
This change takes effect when you confirm.
DomainGuard pause: countdown and Cancel while pending; countdown and Resume while paused. Both actions ask for confirmation.
